subject: Request: In-flight throttle waiver + staged credit to cover burst
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fenixai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production spike — temporary quota increase / credit request

Hi Karthik,

We're seeing a sudden production traffic spike this morning tied to a marketing event — requests and token volume just jumped ~6x for the last two hours. Our app is currently getting throttled at the 750k tokens/day quota and it's affecting live customers.

Quick ask: can Redwood temporarily lift the soft throttle for the next 72 hours (or until we complete this campaign) and provide a provisional credit for any overrun while we finalize a longer-term commit? We can share the usage snapshot and the event plan.

Attached: usage_snapshot_20260807.csv (shows per-minute token rates).

We understand this is an exception; we prefer a short staged arrangement rather than a permanent tier change. Happy to sign an addendum if needed.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if helpful.

— Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform, Fenix AI
lena.ortiz@fenixai.com
ops@fenixai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fenixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike — temporary quota increase / credit request

Lena — thanks for the heads up and for the attachment. Good to hear early.

High level proposal from our side so we can move fast:
- Immediate: lift the soft throttle to allow an additional 48 hours of elevated throughput (we can enable a 72-hour extension if you confirm).
- Credit: Redwood will apply a provisional 30% credit on tokens consumed above your committed quota for the remediation window, capped at $25k. The credit is conditional on an addendum signed within 10 business days.
- Follow-up: we will prepare a one-page addendum that formalizes the temporary lift, the credit cap, and a defined true-up process for final billing.

Operational asks from Fenix: please share the following so we can enable the waiver safely:
1) A single point of contact (ops contact) and a short blast schedule (start/end times).
2) Confirmation that your workload is idempotent and has retry/backoff configured.
3) Any SSO or token keys you want us to route through the Dedicated pool (if applicable).

Marissa — please review the operational guardrails and confirm we can set the temporary throttle to 1.5M tokens/day for their org id.
Dev — please confirm accounting can provisionally book the credit (cap $25k) and advise the invoicing flow (preview / true-up).

I'll hold the external thread — will update once you confirm the ops details.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fenixai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike — temporary quota increase / credit request

On Fri, Aug 7, 2026 at 10:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> High level proposal from our side so we can move fast:
> - Immediate: lift the soft throttle to allow an additional 48 hours of elevated throughput (we can enable a 72-hour extension if you confirm).
> - Credit: Redwood will apply a provisional 30% credit on tokens consumed above your committed quota for the remediation window, capped at $25k.

Thanks Karthik — operational notes:
- We can set a temporary soft cap of 1.5M tokens/day for org fexa-134 (Fenix AI). That will reduce error noise while preserving system safety.
- We'll enable prefix caching for their most common routes to reduce duplicate token cost during the campaign.
- Requirement: Fenix must notify us 2 hours before any planned surge > 3M tokens/day so we can throttle or route to Dedicated if needed.

Lena — please confirm the org id and whether you want the 48h or 72h window. Also confirm if any API keys should be routed to a dedicated pool (we can do this quickly if keys are provided).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fenixai.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike — temporary quota increase / credit request

I'm fine with the provisional credit structure with conditions. A few finance clarifications for the addendum:
- Credit: 30% off overrun tokens during the agreed window, capped at $25,000 total. If overrun exceeds the cap we will invoice at standard overrun rates.
- Accounting flow: we will include a provisional credit line on the next invoice as a negative charge; a final true-up will occur after we reconcile actual usage against the addendum and signed DocuSign.
- Timing: the addendum must be signed within 10 business days for the credit to apply. If not signed, standard billing applies retroactively without the credit.

I uploaded a preview invoice and a draft addendum: invoice-preview-aug.xlsx, provisional-addendum-v1.pdf. Lena — the addendum is one page and mostly boilerplate; please review and I'll push to DocuSign when you confirm.

— Dev Patel
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.inference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fenixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, contracts@fenixai.com
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production spike — temporary quota increase / credit request

Lena — confirming next steps and what's enabled now:
1) Immediate: we've enabled a temporary soft throttle increase to 1.5M tokens/day for org id fexa-134 for 72 hours starting now.
2) Credit: provisional 30% credit on overrun, capped at $25k, conditional on a signed addendum within 10 business days.
3) Attachments: provisional-addendum-v1.pdf and invoice-preview-aug.xlsx attached for review.
4) DocuSign: once you confirm acceptance, I'll route the addendum for signature: https://www.docusign.com/txn/ABC123

Operational items for Fenix to confirm in reply:
- Confirm org id (fexa-134) and whether you want keys routed to a Dedicated pool (yes/no).
- Confirm whether you accept the 30% provisional credit and the $25k cap.

If we don't hear back within two hours we'll keep the 72-hour window but will scale back to 48 hours pending confirmation.

Thanks — we'll monitor and Marissa will send a follow-up if we need to open a support ticket.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0182
